reviews.author: Chanwook Lee
reviews.text:
On a day when I visited Sinchon for the first time in a long time to see a concert, I stopped by this pub just for a quick drink. Actually, when I think of pubs, Hongdae comes to mind more than Sinchon, but when I looked at the European beer lineup, I was curious because it never fell behind.

Like an alcoholic, I was a little embarrassed as I entered as the first customer at 4pm, but soon the seats began to fill up and I realized why it is called the mecca of Sinchon McDucks. It is quite large and has a variety of seats.

Rather than being sentimental, the overall atmosphere is closer to a sports pub, which is rare in Korea, with soccer-related items hanging everywhere and even a large TV hanging from the ceiling. common in england

They say they have prepared coasters for each brand, and they pay close attention to the taps, from cleaning to pressure and glass management. Additionally, they carefully select beers that are imported in small quantities and change their lineup every week.

I ordered Kölsch because it was nice to have, and I was even more pleased to see that it was available in 500ml in Cologne. And what I realized on this day was that “it tastes best when you drink 200ml” is just a Cologne tradition and there is nothing wrong with 500ml.

I liked the thin, chilled glass, and it had the unique flavor of Kölsch's ale and the refreshing feel of lager at the same time. I also liked the subtle bitterness of the hops, the clean finish, and the refreshing feeling from the carbonation.

In the end, these three elements formed the core axis, and the identity of the ale that met the needs of lager was clearly revealed. I really wanted to go to Cologne again, thanks to the demonstration of the true German working-class aspect.

After promising a return visit, I came by train with my friends about a month later, and there was no Kölsch, so we ordered Helles. Because I ate a lot, I couldn't really taste it, but the beer tastes good when it's a little hoppy.

reviews.author: YennaPPa (Luscious.K)
reviews.text:
#Ewha Womans University #Daehyeon-dong #Naughty

“Students at Ewha Womans University also enjoy drinking here, hehe.”

The only traditional bar in front of Ewha Womans University 
Originally, there were a lot of bars in front of the university, but Ewha Womans University has a strong fashion business district for a long time and there is a large entertainment district called Sinchon, so there was no need to have a bar in front of the university.
Nevertheless, since there must be one for each genre, it can be said that Neersrega, with nearly 40 years of experience, is the best bar in front of Ewha Womans University.
I wondered if the bar in front of the women's college would do well, but as its business history shows, it is hard to get a seat and even though it is full, you can feel from the entrance that this place has a certain charm.

Originally, I thought it was a traditional bar with an old building and a unique university atmosphere, but with the recent boom in residential-commercial development in front of Ewha Womans University, this place was also moved to a new building.
It's been 13 years since I worked in Sinchon, but this is my first time going to Nusre. My expectations that it would be something out of the ordinary were shattered, and as expected, it was a wonderful youthful place where I could feel the aura, noise, and snacks of a bar in front of the university.
I wonder if I can come into such a young atmosphere, but magical things like being swept up in this lively atmosphere and getting drunk are possible here.
So, I’ve been with Ewha University students for 40 years haha.

The snacks are also good for drinking, so I think I'll use them often from now on.
There is such a nice place, but it’s too annoying to walk all the way to Sinchon.

reviews.author: Isac Kim
reviews.text:
A hidden gem in the heart of Sinchon! Cottage lives up to its cozy name with warm wooden interiors and intimate lighting that creates the perfect atmosphere for both casual drinks and deeper conversations.
The menu offers an excellent variety - their craft beer selection is impressive, and the Korean fusion dishes pair wonderfully with drinks. The spicy chicken wings and cheese corn are absolute must-tries. Staff is incredibly friendly and attentive without being intrusive.
What sets this place apart is the authentic pub atmosphere that’s rare to find in university areas. It’s spacious enough for groups but intimate enough for dates. The location is perfect - just a 3-minute walk from Sinchon Station, making it easily accessible. Prices are very reasonable for the quality and portion sizes.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for a genuine pub experience in Seoul!

A hidden gem in the heart of Sinchon! As the name of the cabin suggests, the warm wooden interior and soft lighting make every moment perfect, from casual drinks to honest conversations.
The menu is really great - there's a wide selection of craft beers and Korean fusion snacks that go fantastic with alcohol. In particular, be sure to try the spicy chicken wings and cheese corn. The staff are friendly and take good care of you while maintaining an appropriate distance.
What’s special about this place is its true pub atmosphere, which is hard to find in a college town. It's spacious enough for group gatherings and cozy enough for a date. It's a 3-minute walk from Sinchon Station, so it's easily accessible, and the price is reasonable considering the quality and quantity.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for a real pub experience in Seoul!

reviews.text: The cat is cute and the alcohol is delicious. When you think of bars in movies, dramas, and cartoons, scenes of talking about various things with the bartender who cleans the shaker and having some kind of spiritual connection with the bartender who serves drinks appropriate for the situation come to mind. However, it is true that places called cocktail bars these days are drowned out by loud music and unlimited refill cocktails that cost 7,000 won, making it difficult to even hear what your friend next to you is saying, let alone communicate with the bartender. Of course, this does not mean that this is the case in all bars. However, I can confidently say that among the few bars I've been to in college towns, this one is in the top three. In particular, from what I talked to the owner about, there is only one other place nearby, so I would say it is in the top 2. The alcohol here is delicious and there are even cats, so what could be missing? If you have a passion for bars, I highly recommend visiting this place.

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Located in Sinchon, Seoul, this restaurant boasts a unique atmosphere. Unlike the crowded Hongdae, it has a relatively young and vibrant energy, so you can spend a comfortable and leisurely time. Every year during the cherry blossom season, the cherry blossom trees create a beautiful spectacle, and Youth Street emerges as a popular tourist attraction. Youth Street, which was newly renovated after the pandemic, has an outdoor dining area under an umbrella, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal while enjoying the sunshine. It can be a bit noisy during events such as the Water Gun Festival, but overall it maintains a pleasant atmosphere. Traffic control is sometimes inconvenient, but it also creates a better environment for walking. Perfect for a date or gathering with friends, this place creates an even more captivating atmosphere, especially in spring when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom, making it well worth a visit for a special day. Additionally, this is a place where many people have precious memories. Sensitive people may be moved by memories of the past in Sinchon.

reviews.text: First of all, the manager is kind. When we went, there were a lot of customers, but the part-time worker was sick, so the manager took control alone. It was nice to see each team asking for understanding. The theme I did was the locked exit of the mansion. The theme itself was mostly device-oriented, so there were some difficult parts, but overall it was fun to play. After the game was over, the manager personally explained things to us, and it was fun to learn about the hidden Easter eggs. I was happy to have two photos printed. It seems to be one of the best escape room cafes in Sinchon. However, it may not be good for people who like things on a large scale.

reviews.text: The Ewha Wall at Ewha Womans University is a must-see attraction in Seoul. This artistic wall is not only a symbol of the campus, but also a paradise for photography enthusiasts. You can visit on weekdays without waiting or making a reservation, which is very convenient. The elegant and unique design of the walls blends perfectly with the campus atmosphere, turning every photo into a masterpiece. As a cultural symbol of Korea's best women's university, it provides both an academic atmosphere and architectural beauty. We recommend visiting for about 1-2 hours, and you can have a better experience if you avoid weekends. Whether you're an architecture enthusiast or a regular tourist, this is a cultural attraction you can't miss in Seoul and is well worth a visit for a special occasion.
